programme.desc: 'S1/E1'. Van bekroonde restaurante en wynplase tot gesellige blyplekke en ryk geskiedenis - ons wys jou alles wat Franschhoek besonders maak. Of jy nou 'n fynproewer, wynliefhebber of avontuurlustige reisiger is - Franschhoek wag op jou!

programme.desc: 'S1/E1'. Mandri en Schalk speel komedie-kupido en stuur die eerste paartjies op 'n 'date' met 'n kinkel. Sal dié paartjies die liefdespad saam aandurf, of rol die liefdesbal terug dating-poel toe?

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S16/E1'. In September 2019 word vier mense, waaronder drie kinders, in 'n wendyhuis in Elsiesrivier doodgeskiet.

programme.title: Aneeka se kombuis
programme.desc: 'S1/E1'. Hierdie week kook Aneeka herinneringe - met 'n bietjie spice daarby! Dis Oupa se smoortjie, Ouma se breyani en Ma se sterk opinies, soos onthou en gedeel deur haar spesiale gas. In Aneeka se kombuis is daar liefde op elke bord.

programme.title: Huis SOS
programme.desc: 'S1/E1'. Aanbieder Leon Gropp help Pieter en Lotie Koen om hul nuwe huis in te rig met splinternuwe meubels. 'n Tuinstel kry 'n vars voorkoms met poeierbedekking, en Leon vind ook uit watter handige produkte jy nodig het wanneer jy trek.

programme.title: Wie weet wat?
programme.desc: 'S1/E26'. Cindy, Francois en Jan-Hendrik moet nie net hul beste voet voor sit met die algemene kennis nie, maar sal die oorhand oor mekaar ook moet kry om wenner van die episode te word.

programme.title: Tydlose Skoonheid
programme.desc: 'S1/E3'. Gewone mense deel die inspirerende stories van hoe 'n gesonde leefstyl asook Zinplex-produkte hulle gehelp het om ouerword met meer elegansie en moed aan te pak.

programme.title: Landbouweekliks
programme.desc: 'S31/E3'. Kenneth en Joanne Ball is die rentmeesters van die omgewingskat Shi-awela by Bandelierkop in Limpopo. Hulle spits hulself toe op die Amerikaanse mark vir hul jagsafari's, en Nguni's speel ook 'n belangrike rol in veldbestuur.

programme.title: Tuin en Spens
programme.desc: In hierdie dokumentêr deel die kunstenaar en skrywer, Louis Jansen van Vuuren, hoe jy 'n vegan-leefstyl maklik en lekker kan aanpak.

programme.title: Die Liefde Is 'n Snaakse Ding
programme.desc: 'S1/E8'. Spoed-, blind-... Hierdie enkellopendes het al alle tipes dating aangepak. Dis tyd vir Schalk en Mandri se metode. Gaan die paartjies vasklou aan die liefde, of eerder 'n U-draai terug dating-poel toe maak?

programme.title: Kom Ons Braai
programme.desc: 'S20/E3'. Drie spanne kompeteer teen mekaar agter die kompetisievure in Mpumalanga se eMalahleni (Witbank) en Middelburg en almal dink hulle ken van kole krap.

programme.title: Kom Ons Braai
programme.desc: 'S11/E3'. Ons gunstelingtydverdryf is nou 'n sosiale eksperiment. Drie paartjies wat mekaar nie ken nie, braai by mekaar en heelwat gebeur om die vuur. En ons praat nie net van die lekker kos nie!

programme.title: Aneeka se kombuis
programme.desc: 'S1/E2'. Rugby is serious business... maar in Aneeka se kombuis is daar altyd plek vir lag en liefde. Sy wys wat sy vir Embrose kook voor 'n wedstryd - van gebakte oats tot magic pasta.

programme.title: Huis SOS
programme.desc: 'S1/E2'. Die voormalige Protea-netbalspeler en TV-aanbieder Vanes-Mari du Toit kry 'n stylvolle en funksionele kantoorruimte.

programme.title: Slim Vang Sy Baas: Musiek
programme.desc: 'S1/E2'. Twee groepe radio-omroepers van die kampusradiostasie MFM spook dit uit teen mekaar om te sien wie moontlik met prysgeld van tot R10 000 kan wegstap.

programme.title: Dorpie-doenlys
programme.desc: 'S1/E2'. Ons kuier op die skilderagtige Montagu - waar warmbronne, historiese straatjies en asemrowende natuur op jou wag. Geniet plaaslike kos, stap op die bergpaaie, gaan op 'n safari en kom ontspan soos net Montagu kan.

programme.title: #WhatAYear: WTC Final - RSA v AUS D1
programme.desc: 'ICC World Test Championship Blitz Highlights - Final: South Africa vs Australia Test Day 1'. Highlights of the opening exchanges at the Test Championship final. See who drew first blood in London.

programme.title: #WhatAYear: WTC Final - RSA v AUS D2
programme.desc: 'ICC World Test Championship Blitz Highlights - Final: South Africa vs Australia Test Day 2'. Catch the best action from the second day. Gritty partnerships and fiery spells define this session of play.

programme.title: #WhatAYear: WTC Final - RSA v AUS D3
programme.desc: 'ICC World Test Championship Blitz Highlights - Final: South Africa vs Australia Test Day 3'. Recap the pivotal third day where the match swung in the balance. A showcase of test cricket resilience.

programme.title: #WhatAYear: WTC Final - RSA v AUS D4
programme.desc: 'ICC World Test Championship Blitz Highlights - Final: South Africa vs Australia Test Day 4'. The tension peaks in these highlights from day four. Every run and wicket counts as the finish line approaches.

programme.title: #WhatAYear: RUG Champs HL: RSA v AUS
programme.desc: 'The Castle Lager Rugby Championship Blitz Highlights: South Africa vs Australia'. Australia stunned South Africa in the opening Test. The Boks hit back in Round 2 with a far more composed and clinical performance.

programme.title: #WhatAYear: RUG Champs HL: NZL v RSA
programme.desc: 'The Castle Lager Rugby Championship Blitz Highlights - New Zealand vs South Africa'. New Zealand extended their Eden Park dominance in Round 3 but the Boks hit back in Round 4 with a brilliant comeback overturning a first-half deficit.

programme.title: #WhatAYear: RUG Champs HL: RSA v ARG
programme.desc: 'The Castle Lager Rugby Championship Blitz Highlights - Round 5: South Africa vs Argentina'. The Springboks retained the Rugby Championship despite Argentina's relentless pressure, marked by industrious runs and attacks on their defence.

programme.title: WhatAYear WCH: 10000m Final
programme.desc: 'World Athletics Championships Blitz Highlights - 10000m Final'. Elite athletes battle for supremacy in the 10,000m final, grit, speed, and glory on the world stage!

programme.title: WhatAYear WCH: 3000m Steeple Chase FNL
programme.desc: 'World Athletics Championships Blitz Highlights - 3000m Steeple Chase Final'. Speed meets stamina as champions leap barriers in the electrifying 3000m steeplechase showdown.

programme.title: WhatAYear WCH: 1500m Final (W)
programme.desc: 'World Athletics Championships Blitz Highlights - 1500m Final Women'. Elite women clash in speed, tactics, and glory in a race to remember.

programme.title: WhatAYear WCH: 110m Hurdles Final
programme.desc: 'World Athletics Championships Blitz Highlights - 110m Hurdles Final'. Every hurdle counts,watch elite sprinters battle for glory in the electrifying 110m hurdles final.

programme.title: WhatAYear WCH: 400m Hurdles Final
programme.desc: 'World Athletics Championships Blitz Highlights - 400m Hurdles Final'. Who will conquer the barriers and claim gold in the 400m Hurdles Final? Don't miss the action.

programme.title: WCH HL 400m Hurdles Final (W)
programme.desc: 'World Athletics Championships Blitz Highlights - 400m Hurdles Final Women'. The world's top hurdlers battle for gold in the ultimate test of speed, endurance, and technique.

programme.title: WhatAYear WCH: 200m Final
programme.desc: 'World Athletics Championships Blitz Highlights - 200m Final'. Track giants collide for ultimate glory. Who will claim Olympic gold in the blistering 200m sprint final?

programme.title: WhatAYear WCH: 200m Final (W)
programme.desc: 'World Athletics Championships Blitz Highlights - 200m Final Women'. The fastest women on earth compete for gold in the highly anticipated 200m dash final.

programme.title: WhatAYear WCH: 100m Final (W)
programme.desc: 'World Athletics Championships Blitz Highlights - 100m Final Women'. The world's fastest women go head-to-head, every millisecond counts in this electrifying 100m final!

programme.title: WhatAYear WCH: 100m Final
programme.desc: 'World Athletics Championships Blitz Highlights - 100m Final'. The world's fastest athletes clash in the 100m final, explosive speed and glory in every stride.

programme.title: WCH HL 4x400m Relay Final (W)
programme.desc: 'World Athletics Championships Blitz Highlights - 4x400m Relay Final Women'. Four runners, one goal. Don't miss the thrilling final leg as nations battle for gold.

programme.title: WhatAYear WCH: 4x400m Relay Final
programme.desc: 'World Athletics Championships Blitz Highlights - 4x400m Relay Final'. Witness track and field history. Nations clash for glory in the electrifying 4x400m relay final.

programme.title: WhatAYear WCH: 4x100m Final (W)
programme.desc: 'World Athletics Championships Blitz Highlights - 4x100m Final Women'. The pinnacle of team sprinting. Nations battle for the top prize in the electrifying Women's 4x100m relay final.

programme.title: WhatAYear WCH: 4x100m Final
programme.desc: 'World Athletics Championships Blitz Highlights - 4x100m Final'. National pride is on the line as the fastest quartets on Earth chase Olympic glory in Tokyo. Expect blazing speed and high drama!

programme.title: #WhatAYear The Masters
programme.desc: Day 4. Augusta was electric, two giants traded blows, birdies fell, nerves cracked. One man claimed the green jacket in a playoff thriller. Who was it?

programme.title: #WhatAYear PGA Championship
programme.desc: 'PGA Championship Blitz Highlights - Day 4'. Quail Hollow was unforgiving leaders traded blows, tension soared and history waited. One player emerged to claim the Wanamaker Trophy.

programme.title: #WhatAYear US Open Golf
programme.desc: Day 4. Oakmont turned brutal rain delays, wild swings and a leaderboard packed with contenders. One player delivered a jaw-dropping finish to claim glory.

programme.title: #WhatAYear The Open Championship
programme.desc: 'The Open Championship Blitz Highlights - Day 4'. Royal Troon delivered pure drama, winds roared, nerves cracked and legends battled to the final putt. One player etched their name in history.

programme.title: #WhatAYear Ryder Cup
programme.desc: Day 3. The Ryder Cup crackled with energy as cheers roared, pressure soared and pride hung in the balance until one side claimed victory in a nail-biting finish.

programme.title: #WhatAYear: Carabao Cup 24/25 Champs
programme.desc: 'Carabao Cup Blitz Highlights - Final: Liverpool vs Newcastle United'. Newcastle's triumph marked a new chapter of ambition and resilience in English cup football.

programme.title: #WhatAYear: FA Cup 24/25 Final
programme.desc: 'Emirates FA Cup Blitz Highlights - Final: Crystal Palace vs Manchester City'. A historic victory that showcased grit and tactical brilliance on the biggest domestic stage.

programme.title: #WhatAYear: UEL 24/25 Champs
programme.desc: 'UEFA Europa League Blitz Highlights - Final: Tottenham Hotspur vs Manchester United'. Spurs conquered Europe with determination and flair, sealing a memorable continental campaign.

programme.title: #WhatAYear: UCL 24/25 Champs
programme.desc: 'UEFA Champions League Blitz Highlights - Final: Paris Saint-Germain vs Inter Milan'. PSG fulfilled their long-awaited dream, rising to the pinnacle of European football.

programme.title: #HereForHer: Roland Garros (W) Final
programme.desc: 'Roland Garros Highlights - Women's Final: Aryna Sabalenka vs Coco Gauff'. Sabalenka dominated early, taking a 4-1 lead thanks, however in a tense decider, Gauff secured a crucial break mid-set and maintained composure to close it 6-4.

programme.title: Roland Garros HL '25: (M) Final

programme.title: #HereforHer: Aus Open (W) Final
programme.desc: 'Australian Open Highlights - Women's Final: Aryna Sabalenka vs Madison Keys'. Sabalenka won 33 of her previous 34 matches. But Keys is one of the few players on the WTA Tour who has the weapons to damage Sabalenka.

programme.title: Aus Open HL '25: (M) Final

programme.title: #HereForHer: US Open (W) Final
programme.desc: 'US Open Tennis Highlights - Women's Final: Aryna Sabalenka vs Amanda Anisimova'. A dominant first set by Sabalenka showcasing control followed by a second set showdown with Anosimva forcing a tiebreak after breaking a serve.

programme.title: US Open HL '25: (M) Final

programme.title: #WhatAYear: WTA1000 Madrid Open Final
programme.desc: 'WTA 1000 Highlights - Mutua Madrid Open Final: Aryna Sabalenka vs Coco Gauff'. A third Madrid crown tied the tournament record, 9th WTA 1000 & 20th career title, first since Serena to win Miami & Madrid same year.

programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Biz Stream Special Edition
programme.desc: Beyond Space - Combining Storage with New Services: From hotels to multi-purpose lockers, this episode features innovative storage-based business models.

programme.title: Activate Your Japanese
programme.desc: Learn how to make the most of your Japanese skills - watch our drama that features useful communication strategies, our snappy videos about onomatopoeia, and our documentaries on 'senpai' in Japan.

programme.title: Bosai: Be Prepared
programme.desc: Winter Fire Precautions: The fact that Japan is dry in winter greatly increases the risk of fire - we learn tips for preventing fires occurring and how to respond effectively when a fire breaks out.

programme.title: Hello! NHK World-Japan
programme.desc: 'IMPACTS' uses science and data to convey the reality of climate change. A November series-coinciding with the COP30 summit in Brazil-featured five COP-related shows and an Amazon rainforest special.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: The World Heritage Sites In Japan
programme.desc: From natural landscapes to historic architecture representing centuries of cultural development, Japan's World Heritage sites offer a wide range of glimpses into history and the beauty of nature.

programme.title: On The Wings
programme.desc: Journey through the air on virtual excursions from Tokyo Haneda to regional airports all over Japan - this time it's New Ishigaki Airport, islands in an emerald sea from over 40,000 feet up.

programme.title: Hometown Stories
programme.desc: A farm brings together people with something in common: fear of developing dementia. As they engage in planting and harvesting, staff members observe their actions and help them find a way forward.

programme.title: Journeys In Japan
programme.desc: In the Izumo region (Shimane), Sheila Cliffe discovers many superb gardens, both traditional and contemporary.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: My Street Piano
programme.desc: Shibuya is one of Tokyo's largest cities - a piano is placed near a ticket gate at the station and people stop to play from their heart.

programme.title: Dining With The Chef
programme.desc: Chef Rika's kara-age is perfect as a main dish, snack or lunchbox treat - try her easy 'all one' recipe and savour an original recipe that's been passed down for years at a renowned Tokyo restaurant.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Matsuri: The Heartbeat Of Japan
programme.desc: On New Year's Eve, performers dress as monsters called namahage - it's a good-natured tradition that strengthens family and community bonds, and it was recently revived in the village of Tayazawa.

programme.title: Herbal Symphony
